title: AI Engineer (Agents)
description: We are looking for an AI Engineer with experience building LLM agents and RAG pipelines. Must-have: Python, LangChain or LangGraph, RAG, vector databases, FastAPI, Docker. You will design multi-agent systems with tool calling, build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and evaluate LLM outputs. Experience with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation required. Fully remote position.

title: AI Engineer (Agents) Remote
description: AI Engineer with LLM agents and RAG pipelines experience. Python, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, vector databases, FastAPI, Docker. Multi-agent systems, tool calling, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation. Fully remote.

title: Frontend Developer
description: We need a frontend developer with React, Vue, TypeScript, CSS, and Figma skills. 2 years experience. On-site in New York. You will build beautiful customer-facing interfaces and collaborate with designers.

title: ML Engineer
description: Machine Learning Engineer with PyTorch, deep learning, NLP, and time-series analysis skills. You will train and evaluate models with scikit-learn and XGBoost, run ML experimentation, and build reproducible pipelines. Experience with model evaluation and statistical analysis required. 2+ years. Fully remote.

title: AI Research Intern
description: AI research internship for students. Work on neural networks, PyTorch, graph neural networks, physics-informed models, and scientific computing (NumPy, SciPy). Publish research and build reproducible pipelines. Quantitative research skills a plus. Fully remote.

title: LLM Application Developer
description: Build LLM-powered applications: prompt engineering, context engineering, OpenAI API or Claude API, RAG with vector databases, fine-tuning, Ollama, LLaMA. Python and FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL and Redis. Docker deployment. Fully remote.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: DevOps Engineer with strong Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, and Linux skills. You will manage observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana) and automate everything. 4+ years experience. Hybrid position.
